summary: 20-year-old man fell off his inner tube in rapids on the South Platte River in Sheridan; searchers failed to find him; search resumed June 23 with Chatfield Dam releases slowed to lower the river, still unlocated at that point.
notes: INSERT run979; outcome unresolved as of the June 23 follow-up (search resumed with lowered river, still unlocated); later outcome unknown.
